id: 14_Replace the Rocker Switch for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机电源开关的规范更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/14_Replace the Rocker Switch for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/14_Replace the Rocker Switch for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.S1: 认读开关上的 I 和 O
points.S3: 关机顺序：先停光，再关电

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光焊接机背面，指着一个红色船形开关，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the back of a gray wheeled laser welding machine, points at a red illuminated rocker switch, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机的电源开关怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机电源开关的规范更换

shots.scene: 四个图标：开关、火花、手掌、两个人
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a rocker switch, a spark, a hand and two people side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 开关天天用，坏了也要按规矩换。

shots.scene: 阿杰按下船形开关，开关里闪了一下火花，有一缕烟
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the red rocker switch; a small spark flashes inside it and a wisp of smoke rises.
shots.narration: 阿杰一按开关，里面啪地闪了一下。

shots.scene: 阿杰想再按几下试试，小研抓住他的手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches to press the switch again, but the female graduate student holds his hand back.
shots.narration: 他还想多按几下，被小研拦住了。

shots.scene: 小研拔下插头，老李走过来查看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student unplugs the machine and the facility engineer comes over to look.
shots.narration: 小研先拔掉插头，请老李来换开关。

shots.scene: 开关打火、发烫、冒焦烟、指示灯不亮四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four warning icons in a row: a switch with a spark, a switch with heat waves, a switch with dark smoke and a switch with a dark indicator light. No people.
shots.narration: 打火、发烫、焦味、灯不亮，都是故障。

shots.scene: 反复按开关试的手被打叉，旁边空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger pressing a faulty switch again and again, crossed out with a red X, next to a blank out-of-service tag. No people.
shots.narration: 别反复试，拔插头、挂牌、报修。

shots.section_title: 认读开关上的 I 和 O
shots.scene: 红色船形开关特写，一端印着竖线，一端印着圆圈
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a red rocker switch with a vertical line symbol on one end and a circle symbol on the other end. No people.
shots.narration: 开关上的竖线表示通，圆圈表示断。
overlay: 认读开关上的 I 和 O

shots.section_title: 认读开关上的 I 和 O
shots.scene: 欣欣按到圆圈一侧，开关灯熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot presses the circle side of the switch and its light goes out.
shots.narration: 按到圆圈一侧，灯灭，才算关了。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 换开关也要拆机，只限专业人员。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后仍有残余高压，要等待。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 小研站在老李旁边，手边就是墙上的配电开关
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands next to the facility engineer, within reach of the wall circuit breaker.
shots.narration: 维修时旁边要有人监护。

shots.scene: 一个人独自在机器里操作的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a single person working alone inside an open machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 出了意外，监护人能马上断电呼救。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把一字螺丝刀和一个新的红色船形开关
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers, one flat-head screwdriver and a new red rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 两把十字刀、一字刀和新开关。

shots.scene: 焊机背面接口全部空着
shots.prompt_en: The back of the laser welding machine with all sockets empty and the unplugged cables coiled on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 确认所有连接都已断开。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 焊机静静放着，墙上时钟指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The closed laser welding machine stands still while a wall clock shows time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 静置一段时间，放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊机左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the hinged left side door of the machine.
shots.narration: 打开左侧门板。

shots.scene: 老李拆送丝安装板周边螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws around the wire feeder mounting plate.
shots.narration: 拆下安装板十四颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 老李拆黄绿色接地线的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screw of the yellow-green earth wire.
shots.narration: 拆下接地线螺钉。

shots.scene: 安装板放平，露出机内电气区
shots.prompt_en: The mounting plate is laid outward, revealing the wiring inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 放平安装板。

shots.scene: 老李打开头灯，机内深处被照亮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches on a headlamp and the deep corner of the cabinet lights up.
shots.narration: 开关在机身深处，先把光线照亮。

shots.scene: 工具整齐摆在托盘里，另一边工具散落在机器里的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Tools arranged neatly in a tray, next to an icon of tools scattered inside a machine crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 工具放托盘，不往机器里随手搁。

shots.scene: 一字刀压住端子上的弹片，另一只手同时把导线拔出
shots.prompt_en: Close view: a flat-head screwdriver presses the spring clip on a push-in terminal while the other hand pulls the wire out at the same time.
shots.narration: 一字刀压住端子弹片，同时拔线。

shots.scene: 四根线逐根拆下
shots.prompt_en: The four wires are removed from the switch terminals one by one.
shots.narration: 四根线一根一根拆下来。

shots.scene: 示意图：一字刀压下开关角上的凸起卡扣
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: a flat-head screwdriver presses down a raised latch at the corner of the rocker switch body. No people.
shots.narration: 一字刀压下开关角上的卡扣。

shots.scene: 开关从面板另一侧被推出，取下
shots.prompt_en: The rocker switch is pushed out through the panel from the other side and removed.
shots.narration: 从面板另一侧把开关推出来。

shots.scene: 老李在机身背面把新开关按进安装孔
shots.prompt_en: At the back of the machine, the facility engineer presses the new rocker switch into its mounting hole.
shots.narration: 新开关从外侧按进安装孔。

shots.scene: 按入的瞬间出现咔嗒音符图标
shots.prompt_en: As the switch snaps into place, a small click sound icon appears beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 听到咔嗒一声，说明装牢了。

shots.scene: 导线插进端子，出现咔嗒音符图标
shots.prompt_en: A wire is pushed into a push-in terminal on the back of the switch and a small click sound icon appears.
shots.narration: 四根线逐根插回，咔嗒一声到位。

shots.scene: 四根不同颜色的线和参考图用虚线对应
shots.prompt_en: Split view: a blank reference wiring picture and the four colored wires on the switch, with matching dotted lines. No people.
shots.narration: 每根线的颜色，都要对上端子。

shots.scene: 两根线插反、开关冒火花的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two swapped wires on a switch with a spark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插反了，开关可能断不开电。

shots.scene: 老李抬回安装板，接送丝电机线，装回接地线和螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the mounting plate back, plugs in the wire feeder motor cable, refits the earth wire and screws.
shots.narration: 接回电机线、接地线，装回螺钉。

shots.scene: 关上左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: The left side door is closed.
shots.narration: 关好左侧门板。

shots.section_title: 关机顺序：先停光，再关电
shots.scene: 关机步骤：松开焊枪扳机、焊枪挂回、按开关圆圈侧
shots.prompt_en: A three-step diagram joined by arrows: a hand releasing the welding gun trigger, the gun hung on its holder, and a finger pressing the circle side of the rocker switch. No people.
shots.narration: 关机先停出光，挂好焊枪，再关开关。
overlay: 关机顺序：先停光，再关电

shots.section_title: 关机顺序：先停光，再关电
shots.scene: 焊接时直接拍开关断电的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand slapping the power switch off in the middle of welding, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要在焊接中途直接拍开关。

shots.section_title: 关机顺序：先停光，再关电
shots.scene: 红色急停按钮特写，旁边闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the red emergency stop button next to a lightning bolt icon. No people.
shots.narration: 真有危险，按的是急停按钮。

shots.scene: 湿手按开关的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet dripping hand pressing a rocker switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 湿手、油手，不碰开关。

shots.scene: 阿杰擦干手，再按开关
shots.prompt_en: The young male student dries his hands on a towel, then presses the switch.
shots.narration: 擦干再操作，开关周围不放水杯。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机背面，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the back of the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a switch with line and circle symbols, a spark, a gun on a holder and two people.
shots.narration: 认得通和断，异常就停用。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 先停光再关电，维修要有人陪。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手，开关指示灯亮着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye beside the machine with its switch light glowing.
shots.narration: 小开关，大责任。下次见！
